verdicts.reason: A keeps a clear left-to-right order (shoe, headline, copy, badge, CTA), but the shoe is shrunk to an icon, the headline breaks awkwardly onto two lines as 'The Volt / Runner', the 3-line body copy is very small, and the LIMITED pill is nearly as big as Enter Now, so the two compete. B's single-line headline is strong, but the shoe is a speck squeezed into the top-right with the LIMITED badge jammed against it and the top edge. The button is stacked tightly under them, so the right cluster is cramped, the product comes after the copy, and the body text is even tinier.
